mapper.sql:
photo_mst.account_no = #{photoAccountNo} AND photo_mst.is_deleted = false
AND photo_mst.direction_kbn = #{directionKbn}::photo.direction_enum
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM photo.photo_favorite WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND favorite_photo_account_no = photo_mst.account_no AND favorite_photo_no = photo_mst.photo_no )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM photo.photo_tag_mst photo_tag_mst WHERE photo_tag_mst.account_no = photo_mst.account_no AND photo_tag_mst.photo_no = photo_mst.photo_no AND (photo_tag_mst.tag_japanese_name = #{tag} OR photo_tag_mst.tag_english_name = #{tag}) )

choose.when: ORDER BY TO_CHAR(${alias}.photo_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo', 'MMDD') DESC, ${alias}.photo_at DESC, ${alias}.photo_no ASC

WITH countOfFavorite AS ( SELECT favorite_photo_account_no, favorite_photo_no, count(*) as favoriteCount FROM photo.photo_favorite WHERE favorite_photo_account_no = #{photoAccountNo} GROUP BY favorite_photo_account_no, favorite_photo_no ) SELECT photo_mst.account_no AS accountNo, photo_mst.photo_no AS photoNo, CASE WHEN countOfFavorite.favoriteCount > 0 THEN countOfFavorite.favoriteCount ELSE 0 END AS favoriteCount, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM photo.photo_favorite WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND favorite_photo_account_no = photo_mst.account_no AND favorite_photo_no = photo_mst.photo_no ) AS isFavorite, photo_mst.photo_at AS photoAt, photo_mst.image_file_path AS imageFilePath, photo_mst.caption AS caption, photo_mst.direction_kbn AS directionKbn FROM photo.photo_mst photo_mst LEFT JOIN countOfFavorite ON photo_mst.account_no = countOfFavorite.favorite_photo_account_no AND photo_mst.photo_no = countOfFavorite.favorite_photo_no
ORDER BY favoriteCount DESC, photo_mst.photo_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
choose.otherwise:
WITH pagedPhotos AS ( SELECT photo_mst.account_no, photo_mst.photo_no, photo_mst.photo_at, photo_mst.image_file_path, photo_mst.caption, photo_mst.direction_kbn FROM photo.photo_mst photo_mst
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) SELECT pagedPhotos.account_no AS accountNo, pagedPhotos.photo_no AS photoNo, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo.photo_favorite WHERE favorite_photo_account_no = pagedPhotos.account_no AND favorite_photo_no = pagedPhotos.photo_no ) AS favoriteCount, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM photo.photo_favorite WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND favorite_photo_account_no = pagedPhotos.account_no AND favorite_photo_no = pagedPhotos.photo_no ) AS isFavorite, pagedPhotos.photo_at AS photoAt, pagedPhotos.image_file_path AS imageFilePath, pagedPhotos.caption AS caption, pagedPhotos.direction_kbn AS directionKbn FROM pagedPhotos

mapper.select: SELECT photo_mst.account_no AS accountNo, photo_mst.photo_no AS photoNo, CASE WHEN ( SELECT true FROM photo.photo_favorite WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND favorite_photo_account_no = #{photoAccountNo} AND favorite_photo_no = #{photoNo} ) THEN true ELSE false END AS isFavorite, photo_mst.photo_at AS photoAt, location_mst.location_no AS locationNo, location_mst.address AS address, location_mst.latitude AS latitude, location_mst.longitude AS longitude, location_mst.location_name AS locationName, photo_mst.image_file_path AS imageFilePath, photo_mst.photo_japanese_title AS photoJapaneseTitle, photo_mst.photo_english_title AS photoEnglishTitle, photo_mst.caption AS caption, photo_mst.direction_kbn AS directionKbn, photo_mst.focal_length AS focalLength, photo_mst.f_value AS fValue, photo_mst.shutter_speed AS shutterSpeed, photo_mst.iso AS iso, photo_mst.is_location_public AS isLocationPublic FROM photo.photo_mst photo_mst LEFT JOIN common.location_mst location_mst ON photo_mst.account_no = location_mst.account_no AND photo_mst.location_no = location_mst.location_no AND location_mst.is_deleted = false WHERE photo_mst.account_no = #{photoAccountNo} AND photo_mst.photo_no = #{photoNo} AND photo_mst.is_deleted = false
